text:
Carlos: Quick sync  need a 1-pager for stacking private-offer discounts + HW credits for SI renewals next quarter.

Anya: Agreed. Reps ask if credits should live on the PO or as post-sale rebates. Recommendation? :thinking_face:

Leah: Partners like a single bundled offer for co-marketing. They require commit term (6-12m) to enable HW credits.

Mike: Marketplace constraint: POs must list SKUs/pricing. Flexible kicker tiers mean discrete SKUs or fallback to rebate.

Carlos: Draft play: base PO = 10% off for 12m commit >= $100k; SI add SKU = redeemable credit SKU; HW kicker SKU = partner-funded credit, expires 90 days post-registration.

Anya: Add renewal accelerator: +3% if renewed 30-60 days early.

Leah: Cap stacking: vendor+partner discounts <= 35%; HW credit cap $50k/deal.

Mike: Encode caps in SKU metadata to simplify billing. Example SKU names: PRIV12-100K, SI-CREDIT-10K, HW-KICK-50K.

Carlos: Announcement rules: public co-announcement only if partner approves and deal >= $500k; SI co-marketing ok > $100k; delay HW public comms until shipment milestone.

Anya: Ops tracking: use PO metadata + pilot reconciliation sheet.

Leah: Partners want monthly reconciliation CSV. I'll share template after confirming caps.

Mike: Fallback if marketplace blocks combo SKUs: vendor post-sale rebate documented in PO notes.

Carlos: Actions: Anya drafts one-pager by Thu EOD; Leah confirms caps by Fri; Mike maps SKU naming + fallbacks by Mon; Carlos drafts announcement checklist by Mon.

PartnerBot: Reminder scheduled 7 days before pilot start.
